owner_tasks.title: Buy the domain (.in and .com)
owner_tasks.why: Needed for the site, email, Search Console and listings. Porkbun has an official MCP, flat renewals and free WHOIS privacy. Prices from Porkbun's public API on 2026-11-09: .in 7.83 USD and .com 11.81 USD a year, same on renewal (a 1 USD first-year coupon may apply).
steps: Create a Porkbun account (you do the signup and payment).
Buy isapurindustrialpark.in (primary) and isapurindustrialpark.com (defensive redirect). Recheck availability at checkout.
Keep WHOIS privacy on (free).
Tell me the domain names. I put them in the site config, schema and the NAP file.
owner_tasks.unlocks: Everything below that needs a domain

owner_tasks.title: Cloudflare account, nameservers, Pages
owner_tasks.why: Free DNS, free hosting for the lead site (commercial use allowed) and free email forwarding in one place. Its official MCP lets me edit DNS and Pages for you.
steps: Create a free Cloudflare account.
Add both domains, then change the nameservers at Porkbun to the two Cloudflare ones.
Create an empty Pages project named iip-site (I connect the build later).
Connect the Cloudflare MCP: follow the repo README, sign in through OAuth yourself and approve only DNS, Pages and Email Routing scopes.
owner_tasks.unlocks: Deploy, DNS records, Search Console verification, email routing

owner_tasks.title: Cloudflare MCP authorized (done 2026-11-09)
owner_tasks.why: I added cloudflare-api and astro-docs at user scope for all projects. Cloudflare needs your OAuth click once. After that I can edit DNS, Pages and the Access settings for you.
steps: Verified: whoami returns the owner account. Next: I add DNS, Pages and Email Routing records after the domain is bought.
owner_tasks.unlocks: DNS, Pages deploy, and fixing the OpenSEO Access setting

owner_tasks.title: OpenSEO MCP connected (done 2026-11-09)
owner_tasks.why: Your OpenSEO is already hosted at openseo.tanmay-hq.in. The MCP URL answers with a Cloudflare Access login page, so MCP clients cannot connect. I added the MCP globally; it fails until this one setting is on.
steps: Verified from Claude Desktop: whoami works (self-hosted mode, owner account), list_projects returns one project (Default, crownmont.ca, not ours).
Next on my side: create an IIP project once the domain exists, then keyword research (paid DataForSEO calls only after your yes and a cost estimate).
owner_tasks.unlocks: OpenSEO tools in Claude: keyword research, ranks, audits

owner_tasks.title: DataForSEO account and credits
owner_tasks.why: OpenSEO gets all its keyword, rank and backlink data from DataForSEO. You said about 5K a month. Start small and cap it.
steps: Connected: the DataForSEO MCP works (free balance read shows 1 USD trial credit).
When you are ready: add funds in the DataForSEO account (check their minimum top-up), then set a monthly spend cap. Never paste the API password in chat.
I run a cost estimate before any paid call and wait for your yes.
owner_tasks.unlocks: Real keyword volumes and rank tracking in OpenSEO

owner_tasks.title: OpenSEO hosted on Cloudflare (done, openseo.tanmay-hq.in)
owner_tasks.why: Gives me live search data (volumes, rank, backlinks, audits, AI visibility). Self hosted and MIT licensed.
steps: Already hosted by you. Remaining: add the DataForSEO credentials in the OpenSEO settings and set a spend cap (see the DataForSEO task).
owner_tasks.unlocks: Real keyword map, weekly rank checks, AI visibility tracking

owner_tasks.title: Separate business Google account (my advice: yes)
owner_tasks.why: Recommended: a dedicated account owns the business assets so they are not tied to your personal Gmail. I cannot create accounts, you do. Your personal OpenSEO stays on the personal Cloudflare and Google setup; the business account owns only IIP assets.
steps: Create the account (isapurindustrialpark@gmail.com if free, or the closest variant). Strong unique password in a password manager, 2-step verification, recovery email or phone set to yours.
Make it Owner of the Business Profiles, GA4, GTM and Search Console, and keep your personal account as a second Owner or Manager so you never lose access.
Later, when the domain exists, move to Google Workspace or keep Gmail plus domain email forwarding.
owner_tasks.unlocks: Clean ownership of every Google asset

owner_tasks.title: Google accounts: GA4, GTM, Search Console, Business Profile
owner_tasks.why: Tracking and search data. These are your accounts, so you create them. Google MCPs then let me read reports and edit tags with your approval.
steps: Create a GA4 property (web stream later with the domain) and a GTM web container under your Google account.
Add the domain as a Domain property in Search Console (verify with the DNS TXT record: I add it through the Cloudflare MCP).
Business Profile: keep Phase 1, 2 and 3 as separate profiles, Phase 1 primary, add all to your account, set hours 8 am to 8 pm except Tuesday and fix the phones.
Connect the Google MCPs one by one (you do the OAuth): GA4 official, Search Console, Tag Manager (every write needs your approval), Google Workspace (Sheets and Docs).
owner_tasks.unlocks: Tracking IDs for the site, indexing, query data, profile edits

owner_tasks.title: Business email on the domain
owner_tasks.why: Looks professional and receives form and listing mail. Free path first.
steps: Create the mailbox with Zoho Mail Forever Free (check current free limits), or use Cloudflare Email Routing to forward info@ to your Gmail and send from Gmail.
Add the mail DNS records (I add them through the Cloudflare MCP once connected).
owner_tasks.unlocks: Contact email on the site and listings

owner_tasks.title: Bing Webmaster and IndexNow
owner_tasks.why: Bing feeds ChatGPT search, Copilot and others. Import from Search Console and it is nearly automatic.
steps: After Search Console is done, sign in to Bing Webmaster Tools and import the site.

owner_tasks.title: Approval documents (ask your dad)
owner_tasks.why: No approval claim goes public without a document. The most common caller question is whether it is approved.
steps: Get the Zilla Panchayat map approval and any Section 80 or other papers (photos or scans).
Put them in a private folder and tell me the path. I add an Approvals page and the right markup only with the documents.
owner_tasks.unlocks: Approvals page and the approved claim on the site and Google profile

owner_tasks.title: Photos and video of the park
owner_tasks.why: Real pictures beat any stock photo. The biggest single upgrade for the site and the Google profile.
steps: Shoot: gate and signboard, 50 ft road, street lights, trees, plots with boundary, petrol pump, a drone or wide shot, in daylight and near sunset, landscape and portrait.
Drop the files in a folder and tell me. I resize, convert to WEBP and place them.
owner_tasks.unlocks: Real hero and gallery, Google profile photos

owner_tasks.title: Facts and sales answers
owner_tasks.why: The site cannot state what you have not confirmed. Real questions also decide the FAQ.
steps: Plot sizes beyond 300 sq yards, payment plan, power, water and drainage facts, security, permitted uses.
The 20 questions callers ask and how you answer. My guessed list is in 06_Content/sales-faq-suggestions.md.
Which number is on WhatsApp (the site assumes 9837057800).

owner_tasks.title: Impeccable engine decision
owner_tasks.why: The design skill's detector is a downloaded program. I will not run it. You can run it, or we install Rust and I build it from source.
steps: Option A: run ~/.claude/skills/impeccable/scripts/impeccable context in your own terminal. Option B: install Rust from rustup.rs and I build it from source. Option C: keep the by-hand critique.

owner_tasks.title: Plotting maps and the Google Earth project
owner_tasks.why: Phase 1, 2, 3 and Phase 1 extension maps become clean SVGs, one unit per plot, saved as a brand asset (01_Brand/Plot-Maps) for future projects like a plot selector. Colours on your maps do not matter, I trace boundaries.
steps: Send the plotting maps (images or PDFs) of Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3 and Phase 1 extension.
Send the Google Earth project link, or export it as KML or KMZ. The KML gives exact boundaries.
I will not scrape Google imagery. If you want a satellite backdrop, screenshots from your own Earth project are fine.
Tell me the plot numbers and areas if you have them (sq yards), so plots.json is filled.
owner_tasks.unlocks: SVG maps with selectable plots, future plot selector

owner_tasks.title: On-ground photos, including the Phase 1 extension
owner_tasks.why: Real photos show the rapid growth at the Phase 1 extension and replace stock photos on the site and the Google profile. You said about a week.
steps: Shoot all areas incl. the Phase 1 extension works in progress (dated, wide and close).
Drop them in one folder with the date taken and tell me. I resize, convert to WEBP, and use them where they fit (site, listings, posts).
